NASHVILLE, Tenn. (WSMV) - Tennessee Gov. Bill Lee has ordered an independent third-party review of the state’s execution procedures after death row inmate Christa Pike survived an attempt to execute her by lethal injection, renewing questions about whether the state’s protocol is adequate — and whether it is being properly carried out.

The review comes after the state already undertook a sweeping examination of its lethal-injection procedures in 2022 and later revised its protocol.
